answer_sentences.text: No source says that a UCB may charge a 5% foreclosure charge on floating-rate home loans to individuals.
answer_sentences.quote: "Levy of foreclosure charges/ pre-payment penalty shall be subject to extant instructions."

answer_sentences.text: The cited directions instead say that when charges apply, they must be disclosed and approved, not that a 5% foreclosure charge is permitted.
answer_sentences.quote: "All applicable charges for switching of loans from floating to fixed rate and any other service charges / administrative costs incidental to the exercise of the above options shall be transparently disclosed in the sanction letter"
